data.one_liner: Myanmar calendar widgets with Material 3, Cupertino and Liquid Glass styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides Myanmar calendar widgets, month and year views, date pickers, holiday displays, moon phases, and astrology calculations. It renders in Material 3, Cupertino, or Liquid Glass from a single scope.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app for users in Myanmar that requires local calendar views and date pickers.
You need to display Myanmar calendar dates, moon phases, Sabbath, and astrological data.
You want UI components supporting Material, Cupertino, and Liquid Glass styles from a single scope.
avoid_when: You only need standard Gregorian calendar pickers and widgets.
Your app does not target Myanmar calendar systems.
strengths: Supports multiple visual styles including Material 3, Cupertino, and a custom Liquid Glass style.
Re-exports the myanmar_calendar_dart package for complete API access.
Includes pickers, conversion tools, agenda views, and astrological widgets out of the box.
weaknesses: Niche package restricted exclusively to the Myanmar calendar system.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your app in a MyanmarCalendarScope and optionally precache the glass shader.
